assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
